data.description:
Walking-skeleton M1 slice. Introduces the detected_by tag vocabulary (seven allowed values) and the infer-detected-by.sh helper that the three agent filing paths (411b mutation auto-bug, /dso:fix-bug Phase G, debug-everything) call to set the tag. The helper accepts filing context (caller path, environment signals) and outputs exactly one of the seven values, defaulting to other when context is insufficient. Helper is committed executable with a self-test guard that fails CI if the executable bit is missing. The three agent paths are wired to call the helper and apply the resulting tag at ticket-create time. No human dialogue in this story — that is the create-bug dialogue story.

## Done Definitions

- infer-detected-by.sh prints exactly one of the seven allowed channel values (tests, review-llm, review-human, production, user-report, internal-dogfood, other) for every input combination ← Satisfies: sc-1
- infer-detected-by.sh returns 'other' when filing context is insufficient to infer a more specific channel ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Bugs filed by the 411b mutation auto-bug path, /dso:fix-bug Phase G, and debug-everything carry a detected_by:<channel> tag whose value comes from infer-detected-by.sh ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Unit tests cover each branch of the helper (one test per channel inference path plus the insufficient-context default) ← Satisfies: sc-1
- CI fails when infer-detected-by.sh lacks the executable bit, via a self-test guard invoked from the test suite ← Satisfies: sc-1
- infer-detected-by.sh has the executable bit set in git (verified by git ls-files --stage output showing mode 100755) ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Ensure the helper's output is the single tag value with no trailing whitespace or extra lines — downstream tag-apply commands are sensitive to exact strings.
- [Maintainability] Define the seven allowed values in a single source of truth (a shell constant or sourced file) so the create-bug dialogue story and the bug-type-query story can reuse the vocabulary without drift.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked
data.title: As an agent filing a bug automatically, I want detected_by inferred from filing context, so that mutation, fix-bug, and debug-everything bug tickets carry a channel attribution without human input.
